target: Make every enabled v2.11 background capability prove its real effect and fail closed on hidden fallback, stale coverage, permanent debt, or partial failure.
primary_semantics: Capture persists work without AI; the independent scheduler owns semantic execution and hierarchy; derived indexes and backups expose exact waterlines and failures; runtime health is an effect verdict rather than a process-exit verdict.
invariants: Raw conversation records, source hashes, device authority, and completed-round boundaries remain unchanged.
The native collector never launches or waits for an AI worker.
No stale semantic index is presented as current and keyword retrieval remains available.
No failed backup may leave an unreported Memory Wuxian temporary directory.
Archive-v1 and environment-v1 failures remain isolated and neither stream may report partial failure as success.
Existing user configuration values are preserved during default migration.
v3.0 remains prohibited without its separate incompatible-contract decision.
allowed_changes: Remove the legacy collector AI execution path.
Create due parent-summary work after successful child-summary ingestion.
Normalize legacy Windows maintenance-job path identities and terminate permanent debt explicitly.
Bind semantic indexes to a stable raw-source snapshot and expose stale fallback.
Clean only product-owned incomplete backup directories under the configured backup root.
Correct cloud acknowledgement and partial-failure accounting.
Merge missing release configuration defaults with an exact rollback copy.
Add deterministic runtime-effect and rehearsal gates.
prohibited_changes: Rewrite, normalize, delete, or vectorize authoritative raw history in place.
Treat a process, scheduled task, file existence, mocked result, or zero exit code as effect evidence.
Automatically download a model, install a peer Environment item, or advance device trust.
Delete a formal backup snapshot or a directory not matching the product-owned incomplete-backup contract.
Hide quarantined, invalid, waiting-ack, transient, stale, or uncovered work behind healthy or completed.
before_after_checks: Prove collector capture and ready telemetry advance while AI execution is impossible.
Ingest enough Level-1 summaries to trigger a Level-2 job through the production maintenance path.
Append raw history after semantic indexing and prove semantic failure plus explicit hybrid keyword fallback.
Inject backup interruption and prove the exact temporary directory is removed and logged.
Inject an internal conversation-index hole and an integrity mismatch; repair only the former.
Exercise cloud waiting acknowledgement, no-change replay, transient failure, quarantine, and stream isolation.
Upgrade an old configuration and prove user values, rollback bytes, and added defaults.
Run runtime_effect_gate.py against the exact installed candidate and an isolated archive.
